subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Place value
source.subtopic: Decompose numbers into multiples of hundreds, tens and ones up to 200 (weeks 1-2), 400 (weeks 5-6) and 500 (weeks 7-8)

show.line: Look at 347. Three hundreds, four tens and seven ones. Three hundred and forty seven!

rounds.prompt: Tap the number that is two hundreds, three tens and five ones.
rounds.praise: Yes! Two hundred and thirty five.

rounds.prompt: Count the big hundred blocks. How many hundreds in four hundred?
Which card shows the hundreds in 162?
rounds.praise: Yes! The one in 162 is worth one hundred.

rounds.prompt: In 489, what is the eight worth? Say the number.
Three hundred and six. Tap the number.
rounds.praise: Yes! Three hundreds, no tens, six ones.

rounds.prompt: Hundreds, tens or ones? Put each card in its group.
Which number has a five in the tens place?

hints: Three digits. Hundreds, then tens, then ones.
A zero in the middle means no tens, like 306.

beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Two hundreds and four ones. Two hundred and four!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The four is in the tens place. Two hundred and forty.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Two hundreds, four tens, zero ones. Two hundred and forty!

parent_line: Can break a three digit number into hundreds, tens and ones.
